sections.heading: Dispute Resolution
sections.body: The European Commission provides a platform for online dispute resolution (OS). We are not obliged and not willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

sections.heading: Liability for Content
sections.body: As a service provider, we are responsible for our own content on these pages under § 7(1) TMG. According to §§ 8-10 TMG, we are not obligated to monitor transmitted or stored third-party information.

sections.heading: Liability for Links
sections.body: Our website contains links to external websites. We have no influence on their content and cannot accept any liability. The respective provider is always responsible for the content of linked pages.
